chars.AYMAN: AYMAN: a skinny 20-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white socks, white wireless earbuds
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a 22-year-old Moroccan young woman with long dark wavy hair in a loose ponytail, wearing a lilac satin pyjama set

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Upstairs hallway of a modest Meknes family apartment in the morning. AYMAN tiptoes up to his sister's closed white bedroom door and leans his ear against it, eyes wide, curious and suspicious. Seen from the end of the hallway, head-to-waist framing, his face clearly visible. Soft morning light, zellige tiles on the floor.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of AYMAN with his ear pressed to the closed bedroom door, frowning, holding his breath, puzzled by the total silence behind it. Warm hallway light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AYMAN knocks on the closed white bedroom door with his knuckles, leaning in, annoyed and impatient; the door stays shut. Hallway of a Moroccan apartment, framed from the side, his face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen downstairs: AYMAN stands by a small table set for breakfast that nobody touched — a teapot with glasses of mint tea, msemen, bread, olive oil and a jar of jam, untouched. He scratches his head, suspicious, looking up toward the ceiling.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Back upstairs, AYMAN grips the handle of his sister's closed bedroom door, frozen, eyes wide and mouth half open in shock, as if he just heard a strange noise inside. Dramatic morning light from a window. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.
